ch.title: 更新说明
content: 新增 APK 自动检查更新、系统后台下载和安装引导。
安装前校验 APK 的 SHA-256、包名、版本号和官方签名证书。
新增中英文更新进度、失败重试和安装权限指引。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Adds automatic APK update checks, system-managed background downloads, and guided installation.
Verifies every APK's SHA-256, package name, version, and official signing certificate before installation.
Adds bilingual update progress, retry, and installation-permission guidance.
